tips.text: Aim Glitterlance so both bolts cross the enemy. Pix fires a second bolt, so it slows and hurts most when both land.
Hold Whimsy for the enemy who dives or charges at you or your partner. It turns them into a critter and disarms them.
Before a trade, shield your ranged carry and give them Pix's bolts with Help, Pix!
Hurt and reveal a hiding enemy champion with Help, Pix!
Save Wild Growth for a tank or fighter who is diving in. Enemies around them are knocked up, then slowed.
Use Whimsy on your carry when they need to chase or run away. It gives them Move Speed and Attack Speed.
Stay behind your minions when you auto-attack. Pix's bolts can be intercepted by units in the way.
Keep Whimsy ready for Alistar's approach; polymorphing him stops Headbutt and Pulverize.
Hit Alistar with Glitterlance as he walks up; slowing him makes it harder to reach you.
Stay behind your minions, since Headbutt aims at a unit and he can still reach you; step back after he commits.
Put the Help, Pix! shield on your carry when Alistar looks ready to engage.
Do not use Wild Growth on someone while Alistar's Unbreakable Will is up; he takes much less damage.
Hold Whimsy for when Anivia casts or walks close; it stops her attacking and casting for a moment.
Keep Glitterlance for when Anivia is stuck in place casting. It slows her and pierces through minions.
Don't stand in a straight line with Flash Frost. If it hits you, Frostbite follows for big damage.
Put the Help, Pix! shield on your carry before Anivia pokes them, so they trade through her damage.
Kill her egg after Rebirth triggers, since she cannot act while it lasts.
Use Whimsy on Bard when he walks up to hit with Cosmic Binding; he can't attack while polymorphed, and he moves slowly.
Stay out of line with your own minions and your carry so Cosmic Binding can't hit two targets; the stun needs a second enemy or a wall.
Fight away from walls. Cosmic Binding stuns whoever it slows if it hits terrain behind them.
Poke Bard with Glitterlance when he steps up to collect chimes or place shrines; the slow makes it hard for him to get away.
Watch for Magical Journey portals; Bard's team can use them to flank, and you can use them too.
Save Wild Growth on your tank for when Tempered Fate ends; the stasis blocks it, and you can't cast it while your target is frozen.
Stand behind minions so Rocket Grab hits them instead of you. It only pulls the first enemy it touches.
Use Whimsy on Blitzcrank as he runs at you. It stops his Power Fist attack, because he cannot attack while polymorphed.
Poke Blitzcrank with Glitterlance to keep him back. Hitting him slows him, so he struggles to reach you.
Cast Help, Pix! on your partner early in a fight, because Blitzcrank's Static Field destroys shields.
Stay behind your minions so Brand's Sear hits them instead of you. Without Sear landing, his combo can't start.
Polymorph Brand with Whimsy when he commits to a combo; he can't cast spells while it lasts if you hit him first.
Spread out from your ally so Conflagration and Pyroclasm hit fewer of you. Brand does well when you cluster.
Hit Brand with Glitterlance to slow him and poke him down; he has trouble ending a fight once he's slowed.
Shield your carry with Help, Pix! before Brand's burst lands.
Aim Glitterlance when Braum's shield is down or from an angle; Unbreakable catches missiles from the direction he faces.
Use Whimsy on Braum when he leaps in with Stand Behind Me, so he can't follow up with his stun.
Slow Braum with Glitterlance when he walks up to hit you, then back off before his hits stack up to a stun.
Shield your carry with Help, Pix! when Braum's Winter's Bite is coming; it absorbs the damage.
Stay out of Braum's melee range so Concussive Blows never builds up.
Use Whimsy on Camille when she dashes in with Hookshot, so she can't attack or finish her combo.
Land Glitterlance on Camille when she walks up; she is slowed and easier to hit and poke.
Put Wild Growth on your tank or fighter when Camille dives so enemies near them are knocked up and slowed.
Shield your carry with Help, Pix! when Camille is about to dive; it also gives them Pix's bolts.
Keep your minions between you and Camille's Hookshot reach; she needs walls to start her dive, so stay away from them.
Hit Janna with Glitterlance when she walks up to cast; Pix's extra bolt adds damage and the slow keeps her from escaping.
Save Whimsy for when Janna commits to a Howling Gale or a dive; polymorphing her stops her from helping her team.
Listen for the charge-up of Howling Gale, and step out of its line; it knocks you up.
Put Help, Pix! on your ranged ally so Pix adds bolts with their attacks; shield them when Janna's Zephyr is coming.
Hold back when Janna has Monsoon ready; it pushes your team away from a fight, so wait for it to be used before diving.
Keep minions between you and Karma so Inner Flame hits them first. Step out of line when she aims at you.
Move out of the circle left by a Mantra-empowered Inner Flame at once. It slows you and then bursts for heavy damage.
Use Whimsy on Karma when she tries to tether you or start a fight. She can't fight back while she is polymorphed.
Walk out of range of Focused Resolve to break the tether before it roots you. Karma has to stay close to keep it.
Hit Karma with Glitterlance when she walks up to land her abilities. Each hit on you lowers her Mantra cooldown, so make her pay for it.
Keep Whimsy for Leona as she starts her engage. Polymorphing her stops her attacking and cancels her Shield of Daybreak stun.
Use Glitterlance to slow Leona as she walks up. She has to close the distance, so poke her before she gets there.
Stay out of Zenith Blade range, and keep a minion or ally out of its line. If Leona dashes onto you she roots you.
Put the Help, Pix! shield on your partner when Leona goes in, since she mostly hits whoever she reaches first.
Step out of the center of Solar Flare once you see it land. Only the center stuns, so you can often avoid it.
Hit Lux with Glitterlance as she throws Lucent Singularity; the slow makes it hard for her to escape your follow-up.
Save Whimsy for when Lux commits to a skillshot; polymorphed, she cannot attack or cast, and she is easy to catch.
Stay behind minions so Light Binding hits them first; it only roots the first two enemies it touches.
Put Help, Pix! on your carry for a shield against Lux's poke, and step sideways when a red line shows for Final Spark.
Keep Whimsy ready for when Maokai commits. Polymorphing him stops his attack and gives your team time to fight back.
Don't waste spells on Maokai while he is using Twisted Advance. He can't be targeted, so poke him before or after it.
Stay out of the brush when saplings are around. Slow them down with Glitterlance and walk away from the explosion.
Wild Growth on your partner after Maokai commits makes them tougher and slows him, which helps you turn his engage around.
Save Whimsy for when Mel commits to a fight. Polymorphing her stops her casting, and it is a good answer to her Solar Snare setup.
Hold your Glitterlance until Mel has used Rebuttal. Her nova destroys projectiles that touch it.
Stay out of the line of Solar Snare. If you are rooted, you can be hit by everything she has.
Back off when Mel has hit you a lot. Her Overwhelm stacks can execute you when your health is low.
Wild Growth on your tank or fighter turns a Mel engage around, because it knocks up the enemies near them.
Aim Glitterlance down the lane so both bolts hit Milio and his partner; the enemy is slowed and easy to follow up on.
Polymorph Milio with Whimsy when he commits to a Ultra Mega Fire Kick or walks up to help his partner; he can't fight back while it lasts.
Hide behind minions when Milio's team attacks, because Pix's bolts can be intercepted by units in the way.
Stand behind minions so Ultra Mega Fire Kick hits a minion first and loses its knockback on you.
Put Help, Pix! on your ranged carry for the shield, and to give them Pix's extra damage while you trade.
Stay out of a straight line with Morgana and keep minions between you; Dark Binding stops at the first enemy it hits.
Polymorph Morgana with Whimsy when she walks up, unless Black Shield is up; it blocks the effect.
Poke Morgana with Glitterlance when she steps up to last-hit; it is quick to recast and slows her.
Get out of Tormented Shadow when you are low on health; it hurts more the lower you are.
Put Help, Pix! on your carry, since it shields them from Morgana's burst.
Hide behind minions when Nami targets you; Aqua Prison lands after a short delay, so keep moving sideways and make her miss.
Once Nami misses Aqua Prison, step up and trade with Glitterlance, since her long cooldown leaves her open.
Polymorph Nami with Whimsy when she goes for a cast or runs in to bubble you; she cannot attack while it lasts.
Use Glitterlance to keep Nami slowed when she walks up to bubble; it works at long range.
Wait out Tidecaller's Blessing on her carry before trading; it only lasts a short time.
Sidestep Tidal Wave; it travels slowly. If it hits your team, use Wild Growth on a tank to knock up enemies back.
Keep Whimsy ready for when Nautilus dives in. Polymorphing him stops his attacks, so Staggering Blow and Titan's Wrath don't land.
Stand behind minions. Dredge Line stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way takes the anchor instead of you.
Poke Nautilus with Glitterlance when he walks up for last hits. His slow reach is short, so make him pay for approaching.
When Nautilus casts Riptide next to you, wait for the waves to finish before you run. Running early takes more hits and a slow.
Help, Pix! on your partner gives a shield that helps them survive Depth Charge, so cast it when Nautilus is about to engage.
Hit Neeko with Whimsy the moment she shows herself or starts a combo; she is stuck as a harmless critter and cannot attack or cast.
Aim Glitterlance at Neeko when she walks up for a trade; it slows her and both bolts can hit.
Put Help, Pix! shield on your carry when Neeko is about to throw Tangle-Barbs at them.
Stay out from behind your minions; Tangle-Barbs grows stronger when it hits something first, so stand where it cannot pass through them.
Poke her with Pix bolts from behind your minions, which intercept them less often than you think; keep trading before she can commit.
Use Whimsy on Pantheon as he leaps in. He cannot attack or cast while polymorphed.
Hit Pantheon with Glitterlance as he approaches. The slow keeps him from catching you.
Do not fight him head-on while Aegis Assault is up. Wait it out or step behind him.
Stay in the minion wave, as Pantheon's spear hits the first enemy in its path. Keep your health high, because a thrown Comet Spear hurts low-health targets.
Soften Pantheon's burst on your carry by shielding them with Help, Pix!
Save Whimsy for when Poppy charges in with Heroic Charge or starts charging Keeper's Verdict; it polymorphs her and stops her plan.
Stay away from walls; Heroic Charge into terrain stuns you.
Don't dash or jump near Poppy while Steadfast Presence is active; it stops the dash.
Poke Poppy with Glitterlance from long range to slow her and keep her off you.
Walk over Poppy's dropped buckler to destroy it and deny her shield.
Hit Pyke with Whimsy when he dives in to grab someone; it stops him attacking and slows him.
Fire Glitterlance at Pyke when he backs off to heal; he ends up slowed and loses ground.
Put Help, Pix! on Pyke to see him while he is hidden, so he cannot heal back damage out of sight.
Shield your ally with Help, Pix! when Pyke pulls or stuns them, so they survive his follow-up.
Stay behind minions so Pyke's harpoon is blocked; Bone Skewer stops at the first unit it hits.
Hit Rakan with Whimsy when he dashes in with Grand Entrance or The Quickness; he is polymorphed before he can finish the engage.
Use Glitterlance on Rakan whenever he steps forward; the slow makes it hard for him to reach you or escape.
Stay behind your minions so Pix's bolts and Rakan's Gleaming Quill hit them first, and poke with Glitterlance from long range.
Put Help, Pix! on your carry to shield them against Rakan's engage, and save Wild Growth for when he lands among your team.
Hit Rakan when his partner is far away; he is easier to catch and has fewer ways to move.
Poke Rell with Glitterlance from long range while she walks up; the slow makes it hard for her to reach you.
Polymorph Rell with Whimsy when she mounts up and charges at you or your partner; she can't attack or move normally while it lasts.
Stay behind your minions so Pix's bolts and Rell's approach are blocked, and keep your distance from her lance.
Don't rely on Help, Pix! shields against Shattering Strike; it destroys shields before it stuns.
Wild Growth on your tank is a strong answer when Rell pulls everyone in with Magnet Storm; the knock up and slow punish her team.
Hit Senna with Whimsy when she commits to an attack or a root; she is a ranged champion who relies on her cannon, so polymorph leaves her unable to fight back.
Poke Senna with Glitterlance when she steps up to hit minions; it slows her and the second bolt adds extra damage.
Send Pix at Senna with Help, Pix! to deal damage and reveal her if she hides in Curse of the Black Mist.
Shield your marksman with Help, Pix! before Senna's Last Embrace lands; it also gives Pix to your carry.
Stay out of a straight line with Senna, so Last Embrace can't land on you and root you.
Poke with Glitterlance when Seraphine walks up to last-hit; it slows her and hits at long range.
Polymorph Seraphine with Whimsy when she steps forward to cast her spells; she can't fight back while it lasts.
Stay behind minions when you auto-attack; Pix's bolts get blocked by the first unit they hit.
Save Help, Pix! for your own ranged carry and shield them when Seraphine's Beat Drop is about to land.
At level 6, use Wild Growth on your tank or fighter to knock up and slow Seraphine's side when they commit.
Hold Whimsy for when Shen dashes at you or your carry; the polymorph ruins his taunt play.
Poke Shen with Glitterlance when he is out of position; its slow makes it hard for him to close the gap.
Shen's Spirit's Refuge blocks your Pix bolts and attacks; wait for it to end before you commit to a trade.
Shen has no cheap way into your lane after Shadow Dash; punish him when it is on cooldown.
Once Shen is level 6, expect Stand United to bring him to a fight; keep Whimsy ready for his arrival.
Hit Sona with Glitterlance when she steps up to use Hymn of Valor; she is fragile and the slow makes her hard to escape.
Save Whimsy for Sona when she walks in close. She has little way to protect herself, and her carry can then trade freely.
Cast Help, Pix! on Sona for a damage burst when she gets close; it also reveals her.
Watch for Crescendo; shield your carry with Help, Pix! after the stun lands, and stay spread out so it doesn't catch everyone.
Stay out of Equinox. Walk out of the field before it ends, or you will be rooted and hit again.
Polymorph Soraka with Whimsy when she walks up to heal or cast. Then your team can trade freely.
Fire Glitterlance at Soraka when she heals her partner. The slow makes her Starcall harder to follow up.
Dodge Starcall by moving sideways, because it lands after a short delay. Missing it denies her healing and speed.
Put Help, Pix! on your ranged carry so the shield and extra bolts help them win trades.
Keep your distance from Swain when Nevermove is ready. If you are rooted, his recast pulls you into his range.
Use Whimsy on Swain when he starts to cast Nevermove or walks up to fight. He can't fight back while it lasts.
Hit Swain with Glitterlance as he moves in. The slow makes it harder for him to land his abilities.
Move out of the way of Vision of Empire when you see it appear. It takes a while to land and is easy to dodge.
Use Help, Pix! on Swain to deal damage and reveal him, so he can't retreat unseen after he pokes you.
Hit Tahm Kench with Whimsy when he starts channeling Abyssal Dive. It polymorphs him and should stop the dive, since immobilizing effects cancel it.
Poke him with Glitterlance from long range. It slows him, and the second bolt adds extra damage.
Stay behind your minions when you walk up to attack. Pix's bolts get blocked by units, and Tongue Lash stops at the first enemy it hits.
Shield your carry with Help, Pix! when Tahm Kench has stacks on them, to help them survive a Devour.
Wild Growth on your ally when Tahm Kench dives in. It knocks up enemies around them and slows them.
Use Whimsy on Taric when he walks in to engage; he can't attack while polymorphed.
Hit Taric with Glitterlance when he approaches the minions; he is slowed and his Bravado attacks get harder to land.
Step sideways when Taric starts Dazzle; the beam waits a moment before it bursts, so you can dodge it.
Shield your carry with Help, Pix! before Taric's stun lands or when he trades, so Pix also adds damage to their attacks.
When Taric casts Cosmic Radiance, back off or burst his allies down before it ends; the delay gives you time.
Watch for Thresh starting Death Sentence; it has a long cast time, so sidestep it or stand behind a minion.
Use Whimsy on Thresh when he walks up to hook or Flay; it disarms him and slows him.
Poke Thresh with Glitterlance from long range; it slows him and the second bolt adds damage.
Keep your minions between you and Thresh so Pix's bolts and his hook do not reach you freely.
Put Help, Pix! on your carry before a hook comes; the shield can soak the burst.
Do not fight inside The Box; use Wild Growth on your tank to knock enemies up when they commit.
Use Whimsy on Vel'Koz when he commits to a spell; it also disarms him, and he is easy to catch because he has little mobility.
Land Glitterlance on Vel'Koz to slow him, then follow with Help, Pix! to hit him for damage.
Stay behind minions when you attack so Pix's bolts are not wasted, and so Vel'Koz's spells hit minions first.
Put Help, Pix! on your own shooter before a trade; the shield absorbs part of his burst.
Hold Wild Growth to knock up Vel'Koz if he gets in close; it also interrupts his Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Hit Xerath with Glitterlance when he charges Arcanopulse; he is slowed while charging and is easy to catch.
Polymorph Xerath with Whimsy when he is close to you. It stops him from attacking.
Stay close to Xerath, because Shocking Orb stuns longer the farther it travels. Close up, the stun is short.
Use Help, Pix! on Xerath to reveal him and hurt him when he pokes from range.
Yuumi is untargetable while attached to her partner, so hold Whimsy until she is off them. Then polymorph her and dive her partner.
Hit Yuumi with Glitterlance while she dashes between allies. She is slowed and easy to follow up on.
Fire Glitterlance at the carry, not at Yuumi, who can't be hit while attached. Both bolts pierce, so they can also catch minions' side of the lane.
Use Help, Pix! on your own carry to shield them in trades; Pix then adds bolts to their attacks.
Save Wild Growth for when the enemy commits on your carry, or to knock up the pair for a kill.
Hit Zilean with Glitterlance when he walks up to throw a bomb. He is fragile, so the slow and damage punish him.
Zilean wants two Time Bombs on one target for a stun, so move around and keep your distance from him.
Use Whimsy on Zilean when he commits to a Time Bomb combo, so he can't follow up.
If Zilean uses Chronoshift on an ally, wait until it fades before finishing them off.
Hit Zyra with Glitterlance when she steps up to place seeds or plants; the slow makes it hard for her to keep her range.
Polymorph Zyra with Whimsy when she commits to a fight, since she is fragile and has no escape.
Stand behind minions so Zyra's plants and spells are blocked and cannot reach you easily.
Put Help, Pix! on your ally carry before a trade; the shield absorbs Zyra's damage.
Use Wild Growth on your frontline when Zyra's Stranglethorns lands, or to knock up her team when they dive in.
